item.text: The project creation endpoint had been made idempotent by name, which changed the required behavior: two projects with the same name must remain separate, ordered records. The list query also hid older same-name projects. I’ve removed both behaviors and added a small guard against overlapping UI refreshes appending stale results; I’m checking startup and health now.
